description: This PHP source file defines the Aws\Ses\SesClient class, which provides methods to interact with the Amazon Simple Email Service (SES). It includes method annotations for SES operations, utility functions for generating SMTP passwords, and internal methods used for API documentation filtering.

classes.name: Aws\Ses\SesClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon SES, supporting various email-related operations and utility functions for SMTP password generation.

methods.name: generateSmtpPassword
methods.description: Generates an SMTP password using the provided credentials for deprecated V2 credential compatibility.

methods.name: generateSmtpPasswordV4
methods.description: Generates an SMTP password compatible with AWS Signature Version 4, based on credentials and region.

methods.name: sign
methods.description: Signs a message with a given key using HMAC SHA256.

methods.name: applyDocFilters
methods.description: Internal method to apply documentation filters to the API shapes, adding base64 encoding info.
